beats.text: Our number one story: the president held up a photo and swore it proved a gang tattoo.

beats.caption: Then they looked, and on his knuckles he had MS-13.
beats.label: via ABC News

beats.text: ABC's Terry Moran wasn't having it, so Trump doubled down, live, on camera.

beats.caption: Wait a minute. Terry, Terry, Terry, he did not have the letter MS-13.
beats.label: via ABC News

beats.text: CNN and Al Jazeera later traced those letters to digital editing. PolitiFact rated the whole claim Pants Fire.

beats.caption: It says MS13. That was photoshopped.
beats.label: via ABC News

beats.text: Trump's rebuttal to a photoshop accusation? Wave the printout and demand everyone look at the man's hand.

beats.caption: Don't Photoshop it. Go look at his hand.
beats.label: via ABC News

beats.text: He even offered Moran a private viewing of the exact photo he needed the world to believe was real.

beats.caption: Do you want me to show you the picture? I saw the picture. We'll disagree.
beats.label: via ABC News

beats.text: By the end, he wasn't just wrong about a fake tattoo -- he was performing being right.

beats.caption: No, no, no. He had MS as clear as you can be. Not interpreted.
beats.label: via ABC News
